pages.text: With your alloy furnace fully operational, you can now make powerful alloys to improve your resource collection. One of this alloys is $(bold)bronze$().
Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin, hard enough to make tools and armor.

pages.title: Copper vein
pages.text: Copper is an abundant metal that generates on the overworld, between y=-40 and y=140. You need a $(bold)stone pickaxe$() to mine it.

pages.title: Tin vein
pages.text: Tin is a metal that generates on the overworld, between y=-40 and y=140. You need a $(bold)stone pickaxe$() to mine it. Is usually located near $(bold)copper veins$().
Put your $(bold)raw copper$() and your $(bold)raw tin$() inside the alloy furnace (the order doesn't matter), put any $(bold)fuel$() and you'll get your precious $(bold)bronze$().
